entries.name: Maho Yugawara
entries.description: The Appliyama 470 Election ( アプリ山 ４７０ ( ヨンナナマル ) 総選挙 , Apuriyama 470 ( Yon'nanamaru ) Sousenkyo ? ) is an annual popularity contest where fans vote for their favorite idol through an app distributed by L-Corp . The 9 most popular idols become the 9 GODs . Aim for the 9 GODs! Appliyama 470 Elections! However, this is actually a covert way of gathering info about the voters, as the app also gathers information about the voter's name, sex, address, and family situation. Election Results! The Hands of Evil Aproach Eri!
